rv.q: It's a shame that the Wonderland itself as written in ALICE BY HEART isn't all that wonderful.
Fresh off their Jeff Award-winning 2023 season, Kokandy Productions shows no signs of slowing down with “Alice by Heart,” breathing new life into an old favorite.
This midwest premiere production ably conjures both the fantasy and the painful reality of these people and the war raging above them.
Derek Van Barham and Brittney Brown pull this ensemble into a moving community of young characters that touches our heart.
But the script for this musical feels maddeningly muddled, so much so that it may even confound those familiar with the Lewis Carroll novel.
Alice by Heart is a perfectly charming little musical, especially if you have a special connection to Alice in Wonderland.
This amazing 90 minutes ( no intermission) of whimsical story telling exceeds what I anticipated, making it a must see for anyone who loves Alice!
This modern version of Alice in Wonderland was beyond impressive and unique.

cn.t: Critics find this poignant WWII-set reimagining of Alice in Wonderland emotionally resonant with strong performances, though some feel the musical itself lacks the imagination its premise promises.
